claims.statement: Management expects the current financial year's GMA contribution to be equal to or better than FY 24.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution

claims.statement: Management believes apparel contribution can return to pre-COVID levels.
claims.quote: The way to look at it, Amit, is apparel we believe we can go back to the older days of contribution, which was maybe pre-COVID.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that general merchandise is a larger opportunity in the long term compared to apparel.
claims.quote: The other part is, we see an opportunity in GM, general merchandise to be a larger opportunity in the long term.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management notes it is getting more challenging to maintain a 15% to 20% CAGR growth rate at only 40 stores per annum.
claims.quote: it is getting more and more challenging to maintain a 15% to 20% CAGR growth rate if I continue to grow at only 40 stores per annum.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expresses hope for a better rate of store openings in the year after next.
claims.quote: Maybe not this year, but the year after that, I hope that we will have a better rate of store openings, additions.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts had 573 DMart Ready locations last year and reduced it to 341 this year after shutting down 232 locations.
facts.quote: Percy, we had 573 last year. There are 341 this year, we shut down 232.

facts.statement: Capital commitments represent open purchase orders at the end of the year and depend on the progress of various stages of construction.
facts.quote: So capital commitment, Percy, is an outcome of open purchase orders at the end of the year. It depends on how many purchase orders are in various stages of progress.

facts.statement: Undeveloped land purchased for stores goes into fixed assets rather than capital work-in-progress.
facts.quote: whenever you buy land, even though it's not operational for the store, it goes into your fixed assets, it doesn't go into CWIP.

facts.statement: The worst revenue mix quarter for the business is Q4, the March quarter.
facts.quote: And the worst is Q4, March quarter.
